USA_1970_initialize_policy_decision_systems = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = USA_1970_policy_decisions_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = USA_1970_policy_decisions_initialized
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = USA_1970_vietnam_burden }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = USA_1970_drug_crisis }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_stability = -0.1 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_war_support = -0.12 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_pp = -0.1 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_personnel = 0 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_supply = 0 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_attack = -0.04 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_air_mission = -0.03 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_drug_stability = -0.06 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_drug_pp = -0.08 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_drug_population = -0.04 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_drug_drift_defense = -0.04 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_drug_civ_intel = -0.03 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_drug_police_cost = 0.14 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_drug_health_cost = 0.08 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_drug_bureaucracy_cost = 0.08 }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_military_overextension_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_military_overextension_initialized
		set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_conflict_observed
		if = {
			# Preserve an already-resolved Vietnam burden when loading an older save.
			# The lifetime flags prevent the new staged legacy costs from being
			# charged retroactively or stacked after a later intervention.
			limit = { has_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_burden_resolved }
			set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_settlement_verified
			set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_force_drawdown_completed
			set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_emergency_accounts_closed
			set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_settlement_costs_paid
			set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_drawdown_costs_paid
			set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_emergency_legacy_costs_paid
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = USA_1970_vietnam_burden }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = USA_1970_vietnam_military_overextension }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_personnel = 0 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_army_personnel = 0 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_equipment = 0 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_supply = 0 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_consumer_goods = 0 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_training_time = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_wartime_costs_active
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = USA_1970_vietnam_military_overextension }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_personnel = 0.6 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_army_personnel = 1.5 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_equipment = 0.6 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_supply = 0.5 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_consumer_goods = 0.1 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_training_time = 0.15 }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

USA_1970_restore_vietnam_wartime_costs = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = USA_1970_vietnam_military_overextension } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = USA_1970_vietnam_military_overextension }
		}
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_personnel = 0.6 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_army_personnel = 1.5 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_equipment = 0.6 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_supply = 0.5 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_consumer_goods = 0.1 }
		set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_overextension_training_time = 0.15 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = USA_1970_vietnam_burden } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = USA_1970_vietnam_burden }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_path_ceiling }
			USA_1970_apply_vietnam_operational_ceiling_profile = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_path_vietnamization }
			USA_1970_apply_vietnamization_profile = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_path_leverage }
			USA_1970_apply_vietnam_escalatory_profile = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_stability = -0.1 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_war_support = -0.12 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_pp = -0.1 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_personnel = 0 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_supply = 0 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_attack = -0.04 }
			set_variable = { USA_1970_vietnam_air_mission = -0.03 }
		}
		set_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_wartime_costs_active
		clr_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_burden_resolved
		clr_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_settlement_verified
		clr_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_force_drawdown_completed
		clr_country_flag = USA_1970_vietnam_emergency_accounts_closed
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}
